asked.key: "a judge question that forgets its records still reaches the owner" changed since you answered "yes: it reaches the owner without the you said line; only missing options or plumb's internal words trigger the retry" to "is a judge question with no quote of the owner's words usable?". does your answer still hold for what it says now? then: the judge's answer format requires each question to name the records it settles; when a question still comes back without them, plumb takes the records of the job instead of rejecting it. a question without a quote of the owner's words is usable: it reaches the owner without the "you said" line. only a question missing its options or using plumb's internal words is retried once; still unusable after the retry, it goes to a debug case and its records keep waiting until the debug case fixes the question. the verdicts already given are applied. ex-1: given the judge answers like the 2026-10-16 job: three questions, each without the records it settles, when plumb reads the answer, then the three questions reach the owner through the question tool and no verdict waits ex-2: given the judge's answer format given to the model, when the judge model is asked, then the format is lenient, a question needs only its text, and the judge's instructions and plumb's retry enforce the records and 2 to 4 options (dec-208) ex-3: given a question with one option only, when plumb reads it, then the job is retried once; if it fails again a debug case is written, the question's records keep waiting, and the other verdicts are applied ex-4: given a question with options but no quote of the owner's words, when plumb reads it, then it reaches the owner without the "you said" line and is not retried now: the judge's answer format requires each question to name the records it settles; when a question still comes back without them, plumb takes the records of the job instead of rejecting it. a question without a quote of the owner's words is usable: it reaches the owner without the "you said" line. only a question missing its options is retried once (one using plumb's internal words reaches the agent marked to reword it, sr-362); still unusable after the retry, it goes to a debug case and its records keep waiting until the debug case fixes the question. the verdicts already given are applied. ex-1: given the judge answers like the 2026-10-16 job: three questions, each without the records it settles, when plumb reads the answer, then the three questions reach the owner through the question tool and no verdict waits ex-2: given the judge's answer format given to the model, when the judge model is asked, then the format is lenient, a question needs only its text, and the judge's instructions and plumb's retry enforce the records and 2 to 4 options (dec-208) ex-3: given a question with one option only, when plumb reads it, then the job is retried once; if it fails again a debug case is written, the question's records keep waiting, and the other verdicts are applied ex-4: given a question with options but no quote of the owner's words, when plumb reads it, then it reaches the owner without the "you said" line and is not retried what changed: dec-192 says a question using plumb's internal words triggers the retry, but the requirement now retries only a question missing its options and sends internal-word questions to the agent marked for rewording (sr-362), and the later dec-162 doesn't cover that point. it comes from your decision "is a judge question with no quote of the owner's words usable?" of 2026-10-18 under your request "plumb keeps itself fit at every landing, and parallel loops stay..." (the owner answered through the question tool on 2026-10-17.).

options.label: Yes, the agent rewords it

options.description: Such a question goes back to the judge once, as you agreed on 2026-10-17; if it fails again it waits in a debug case.
options.label: No, the judge redoes it

payload.question: On 2026-10-17 you agreed that a judge question using plumb's own words (a record number, a plumb term) is sent back to the judge to be redone once. Since your complaint that such a question was set aside to the band, it now goes straight to the agent, who puts it in your words and asks you; only a question missing its answer choices is redone. Does that change stand?
